:root{--paper:#fffaf0;--ink:#17345f;--blue:#2453b8;--coral:#ee6959;--line:#dfe5e6;--soft:#f3eee4}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:ui-serif,"Songti SC","STSong",serif}.lesson{max-width:1160px;margin:auto;padding:28px 42px 48px}.topline{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:19px;font:11px ui-monospace,"Cascadia Mono","SFMono-Regular",monospace;letter-spacing:.12em}.brand{color:var(--blue);font-weight:bold;text-decoration:none}.hero{min-height:600px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.05fr;align-items:center;gap:80px}.eyebrow{margin:0 0 16px;color:var(--coral);font:11px ui-monospace,"Cascadia Mono","SFMono-Regular",monospace;letter-spacing:.14em}h1{font-size:clamp(42px,5.2vw,76px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.07em;margin:0 0 24px;font-weight:600}h1 em{color:var(--coral);font-style:normal}.lede{max-width:390px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.9;margin:0;color:#455a77}.chooser{display:flex;gap:9px;margin-top:33px}.chooser button{width:57px;height:51px;border:1px solid #cdd7dc;border-radius:50%;background:#fffdf8;color:var(--blue);font:700 21px ui-monospace,"Cascadia Mono","SFMono-Regular",monospace;cursor:pointer;transition:.25s}.chooser button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:white;box-shadow:0 10px 18px #2453b83b}.keyhint{font:11px ui-monospace,"Cascadia Mono","SFMono-Regular",monospace;color:#6b7d92}.dome-card{padding:24px 27px 25px;border:1px solid #d9e0df;border-radius:28px;background:#fffdf8;box-shadow:18px 22px 0 #eee8dd}.card-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font:11px ui-monospace,"Cascadia Mono","SFMono-Regular",monospace;letter-spacing:.07em;color:#64778b}.card-head strong{color:var(--coral);font-weight:normal}.constellation{height:355px;max-width:310px;margin:8px auto 5px;position:relative}.constellation svg{position:absolute;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}.constellation path{fill:none;stroke:#f39a7f;stroke-width:8;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;opacity:.75;transition:d .55s ease}.dots{position:absolute;inset:26px 35px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px 57px}.dot-slot{display:grid;justify-items:center;align-content:center;gap:8px}.dome{width:63px;height:63px;border-radius:50%;display:block;background:#d9e0e2;box-shadow:inset 9px 9px 12px #fff,inset -8px -9px 12px #bdc8cd,0 5px 8px #6c7f8830;transform:translateY(9px);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1),background .35s,box-shadow .45s}.dome.raised{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff9e8 5%,#8cb1f6 43%,#2453b8 100%);transform:translateY(-7px);box-shadow:inset 9px 9px 14px #fff9e9,inset -11px -12px 15px #163c91,0 18px 17px #2453b850}.dot-slot b{font:11px ui-monospace,"Cascadia Mono","SFMono-Regular",monospace;color:#8290a0}.pattern-copy{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:18px}.pattern-copy h2{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 7px}.pattern-copy p{margin:0;color:#586a7d;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7}.closing{margin-top:28px;padding:42px 44px;border-radius:25px;background:var(--blue);color:white;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:end}.closing .eyebrow{color:#ffb0a0}.closing h2{font-size:34px;line-height:1.22;margin:0}.note{font-size:13px;opacity:.8}.save{min-width:230px;border:0;border-radius:99px;background:var(--coral);color:#fff;padding:17px 21px;font:600 14px ui-serif,"Songti SC","STSong",serif;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 10px 0 #b7443d}.save span{font-size:21px;margin-left:13px}.saved{grid-column:2;margin:0;color:#fff2c7;font-size:13px;min-height:20px}.is-saved .save{background:#fff2c7;color:var(--blue);box-shadow:none;transform:translateY(5px)}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--coral);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:650px){.lesson{padding:12px 14px 18px}.topline{font-size:9px;padding-bottom:8px}.hero{min-height:0;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px;padding:14px 0 12px}.eyebrow{margin-bottom:6px;font-size:9px}h1{font-size:36px;line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.055em;margin-bottom:10px}.lede{font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;max-width:none}.chooser{gap:8px;margin-top:11px}.chooser button{width:42px;height:38px;font-size:17px}.keyhint{display:none}.dome-card{padding:11px 12px 12px;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:7px 9px 0 #eee8dd}.card-head{font-size:9px}.constellation{height:190px;max-width:210px;margin:2px auto 0}.dots{inset:8px 22px;gap:3px 34px}.dot-slot{gap:2px}.dome{width:39px;height:39px;transform:translateY(4px)}.dome.raised{transform:translateY(-4px)}.dot-slot b{font-size:9px}.pattern-copy{padding-top:7px}.pattern-copy h2{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:3px}.pattern-copy p{font-size:10px;line-height:1.35}.closing{margin-top:8px;padding:12px 14px;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:6px;border-radius:18px}.closing .eyebrow{margin:0}.closing h2{display:none}.note{font-size:10px;line-height:1.35}.save{width:100%;min-width:0;padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;box-shadow:0 5px 0 #b7443d}.save span{font-size:16px;margin-left:8px}.saved{grid-column:1;min-height:14px;font-size:10px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
